what_each_new_part_touches: Yellow box (built twice): four black pins go into a 15-hole beam, then two grey 9-hole beams are laid under it on the pins. Each finished side build is lowered along one side of the undercarriage (two black arrows).
where_everything_is_after: a long track rail (15-hole beam over two 9-hole beams) lies along each side of the undercarriage

why.problem_solved: Builds the long track frames that hold the wheels in line and give the track something to slide on.
why.why_these_parts: A 15-hole beam spans from sprocket to sprocket; two 9-hole beams under it add height so the track links ride flat.
why.sets_up_for_later: Steps 14-16 cap the axle ends and wrap the track links around the whole assembly.

review_note: Pin positions along the 15-hole beam are read by eye from sub-step 1 (pins near holes 1, 8, 10, 15) and are estimates. Which pin holds which 9-hole beam is not shown.
